build_get_chat_template: build a tokenizer with a custom Jinja chat template and system message for LLM conversations
create_construct_chat_template: create a custom Ollama modelfile and HuggingFace Jinja chat template from a prompt template with {INPUT} and {OUTPUT} placeholders
apply_chat_template_to_dataset: apply a constructed chat template to a dataset of conversations for supervised fine-tuning
convert_dataset_to_sharegpt: convert a dataset with multiple columns into ShareGPT format with merged instruction and output fields
test_chat_template_equivalence: test that a custom chat template produces identical output to the reference tokenizer's apply_chat_template
